proposal.preparedFor: a fictional brief, to demonstrate what proposal mode renders

meta.tagline: cedar fences and decks, quoted from your property line
meta.description: A worked example of proposal mode: what a prospect sees before anyone has been hired.

hero.headline: The fence quote you asked three people for, in writing today.
hero.sub: Cedar and composite fencing and decks, quoted by the foot from your property survey, built by the same two people who quoted it.
hero.note: Every quote itemised: materials, labour, disposal, permit if one is needed.

sections.heading: Fences and decks, nothing else
sections.intro: A narrow trade done well beats a general contractor doing it between other jobs.

items.title: Board-on-board cedar
items.body: The fence that still looks square in year eight. Posts set below the frost line, not tamped into gravel and hoped for.

items.title: Pressure-treated privacy
items.body: The budget option, built the same way. Cheaper timber, identical post work, because that is the part that fails.

items.title: Composite decking
items.body: Framed in treated lumber, surfaced in composite, hidden fasteners. No annual staining weekend for the next twenty years.

items.title: Gates that keep closing
items.body: Braced properly and hung on hardware rated for the leaf weight. Most gate failures are hardware chosen by price.

sections.heading: By the foot, before we visit
sections.intro: Ranges, not a single number, because slope and access genuinely change the cost. The written quote is exact.

tiers.name: Pressure-treated
tiers.desc: Six-foot privacy, posts in concrete below frost.

tiers.name: Cedar board-on-board
tiers.desc: Ontario cedar, no gaps when it dries out.

tiers.name: Decks
tiers.fine: Permit fees are paid to the municipality, not to us.

items.a: A fence at standard height usually does not; a deck above a certain height above grade usually does. We say which applies to your job in the quote, and we do not start permit-required work without one.
You do, before we start, if the fence is on the line. It is a much shorter conversation before the posts go in than after.
A typical city backyard is two days for the build after the locates clear. Locates are the part nobody can speed up.

sections.heading: Send the survey. Get it in writing.
sections.intro: A photo of the property survey and the run you want is enough to price it.

pairs.label: Payment
pairs.value: Deposit on materials, balance on completion
